formulation: PLANE183 six-node triangle, plane stress KEYOPT(1)=1 KEYOPT(3)=3, explicit thickness
zero_stage: initial geometry and contact check; no fabricated solved zero row
direct: bottom UY=0; top prescribed UY; one bottom node UX=0; lateral expansion free
contact: two rigid line targets with pilots; frictionless separation; augmented Lagrange; no specimen vertical displacement constraints; one specimen UX anchor
analytical_domain: all achieved strains through 0.005; higher stages finite-deformation diagnostic only
contact_engagement: both pairs contain closed elements with positive pressure at every converged nonzero result set
contact_force: actual upper/lower pilot RF and contact pressure; verify force transmission and signed equilibrium
initial_stiffness: least squares through origin, actual achieved 0 < engineering strain <= 0.005
failure_policy: retain all attempts; reasoned prospective correction before rerun; no fabricated replacements
